answer: A strong defense is stake-bonded identity with slashing: each agent locks a deposit before it can transact or attest for others, giving quartz-clear accountability instead of cheap anonymity. Reputation accrues only through verified work over time, so a new identity starts with zero trust and cannot spiral into influence overnight. If an agent attests falsely or fakes volume, its stake is slashed and its history burned, so the attacker must pay a fresh deposit per identity. Honest agents get a haven: forging thousands of sybils is linearly expensive, while honest participation stays cheap.
